title: Swarm Orchestrator Protocol
description: Implements a production-grade Swarm Orchestrator Protocol. Root agent acts as pure delegator. Swarm Orchestrator manages Implementor Swarm + Review Quorum Swarm with quorum-gated parallelism, keyhole feedback routing, Topography Map baseline, and ConsensusArtifact commit gating. Introduces /superconductor:swarm-execute command.
